title: ToolsPanel second column clips off the right — host wrapper width (44px) too small for the 2-column grid (67px panel)
description:
FIXED (task 1274). Root cause confirmed: Shell.tsx tools-panel HOST WRAPPER was hardcoded width:44/minWidth:44 + overflow:hidden, clipping everything past x=44. ToolsPanel's own grid (67px panel, 1px borderRight -> 66px inner; grid = 2x22 + 1px gap + 2x1px padding = 47px, centered) was already correct. The 44px wrapper == single-column width, harmless until task 1267 (d1bb50a) restored repeat(2,22px); then the right column (~x32.5..56.5) clipped at x=44.

FIX: Shell.tsx now imports metrics and sets the wrapper width/minWidth = metrics.toolsPanelWidth (67) so it tracks the spec instead of the magic 44; overflow:hidden kept. WIDTH MATH: wrapper 67 >= panel 67; grid content 47px centered in 66px inner spans x~9.5..56.5, max 56.5 < 67 -> both columns fully visible, no clip, no left bias (symmetric padding + justifyContent:center preserved). Light Halo styling, 1262 button states, and 1267 two-column intent all unchanged.

VERIFY: pnpm --filter './packages/**' build green; pnpm --filter @flash/authoring-ui run test -- --run => 45 files / 666 tests ALL PASS (0 failures, better than the ~3 task-1207 allowance). Diff: packages/authoring-ui/src/Shell.tsx only (15+/2-).
